description: Wait for SPV's answer to a request_document (a RASPUNS SOLICITARE message carrying its id), checking the list every few seconds for up to wait_seconds. SPV usually answers within two minutes. With download, the answer's document is saved to the outbox as download_message saves it. answered: false means not yet; call again. A client that asks for progress hears the seconds waited; cancelling ends the wait.

download.description: Save the answer's document to the outbox when it is there.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the downloads outbox (e.g. "2026-10"); empty means the outbox itself. A path outside it is refused.

wait_seconds.description: How long to keep checking; 0 checks once.

name: await_reply
title: Wait for a request's reply
